name: What preparation is needed before commercial painting begins?
description: Preparation involves cleaning, repairing surfaces, scraping loose paint, and masking non-painted areas to ensure proper adhesion and a quality finish.

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before commercial painting begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Thorough preparation is crucial for a successful commercial painting project. This typically includes cleaning all surfaces to remove dirt, grease, and loose debris. Any cracks, holes, or imperfections will be repaired and patched. Loose or peeling paint must be scraped and sanded smooth. Additionally, all non-painted surfaces, such as windows, trim, and fixtures, are carefully masked and covered to protect them from paint splatter. Proper preparation ensures optimal paint adhesion and a smooth, long-lasting finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation involves cleaning, repairing surfaces, scraping loose paint, and masking non-painted areas to ensure proper adhesion and a quality finish.
